verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The closest items are adjacent: MCP tool categories (read vs. write/delete) that a user approves in their AI client, and per-integration data-in API keys. Neither is a credential-scoping capability for agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
